epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce codebase compliance violations from 10 to 0
requirements: R1: Extract hardcoded magic strings (e.g. email, UUID) into named constants in DocumentController.java
R2: Remove hardcoded PII and secret mocked JWT token from DocumentController.java
R3: Implement proper error logging and handling for IOException in serializeMetadata in DocumentController.java
R4: Replace fake success in /auth/login with real authentication logic
R5: Wire the frontend PDF/DOCX download buttons to make real backend requests
R6: Wire the frontend postComment and sendActualizationRequest functions to make real backend API calls
R7: Separate procedural file I/O operations from HTTP routing logic into a service layer
R8: Remove non-Russian text from the frontend UI
R9: Patch the backend to integrate with the already-existing export endpoints for PDF/DOCX
R10: Patch the backend to use the already-existing endpoints and database models for comments and actualization requests

slices.title: Direct Code Patch
slices.jtbd: When implementing the patches for this epic, I want to wire existing models/APIs and remove hardcoded strings/PII, so that the existing implementation meets the required standards without new layers.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a document controller, When accessed, Then magic strings and PII are not hardcoded.
Given a frontend UI, When interacted with, Then it triggers existing backend calls and displays only Russian text.

slices.title: QA Epic Verification
slices.jtbd: When verifying this epic, I want to ensure all patched code works across the test pyramid, so that regressions are caught early.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the test suite, When run, Then unit tests verify the separated IO logic.
Given the E2E tests, When run, Then the user can successfully download a PDF and submit a comment using the patched integration.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: increase test coverage of DocumentController from 0% to 80%

epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce fake data transmissions from 1 to 0
requirements: R11: Implement real data transmission in sendAnalyticsExport in DefaultEiosClient.java using a new HTTP client layer

slices.title: EIOS HTTP Client Layer
slices.jtbd: When implementing data transmission for this epic, I want to create a real HTTP client layer, so that analytics can be successfully sent to the remote EIOS URL.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an analytics export job, When triggered, Then data is transmitted via the new HTTP client layer to the remote URL.
Given a missing eiosApiUrl, When triggered, Then the HTTP client layer fails explicitly.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce fake export completions from 1 to 0

slices.title: QA Analytics Sync
slices.jtbd: When verifying this epic, I want to ensure the new HTTP client layer functions correctly under real conditions, so that data loss is prevented.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given integration tests, When run, Then they verify successful transmission via the HTTP client to a mock EIOS server.
Given invalid configuration, When run, Then the system throws the expected exception.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: increase integration test coverage of DefaultEiosClient from 0% to 100%
